data.title: Search: light stemming, and separate thresholds to rank and to stay silent
data.description: Phase 1 of tasks/plan-search-quality.md. Measured on a scratch copy: stemming 37 -> 43 first place, 56 -> 68 top 5; the 0.35 coverage gate cuts top 3 from 80 to 66. Rank with a low floor; keep the current gate for the decision to say nothing, so nonsense still gets nothing.
